missions.name: NASA: Explorer 35/ IMP-E
missions.goals: Study plasma, magnetic fields, and radiation near the Moon.
missions.outcome: Success. Conducted a multi-year orbital science mission; the eventual impact site is unknown.

missions.name: Soviet Union: Luna 23
missions.goals: Collect lunar soil and return it to Earth.
missions.outcome: Failure of sample return. Landed damaged and could not return samples.

missions.name: Soviet Union: Luna 22
missions.goals: Map the Moon and study its gravity and environment from orbit.
missions.outcome: Success. Conducted orbital science observations.

missions.name: Soviet Union: Luna 24
missions.goals: Drill into the regolith and return samples to Earth.
missions.outcome: Success. Returned a subsurface lunar sample.

missions.name: NASA: Explorer 49/ RAE-B
missions.goals: Observe low-frequency radio emissions from lunar orbit.
missions.outcome: Success. Conducted radio astronomy observations; the eventual impact site is unknown.

missions.name: Japan: Hiten
missions.goals: Demonstrate lunar flight techniques and deploy the Hagoromo subsatellite.
missions.outcome: Success for the main spacecraft. Completed lunar flight experiments and ended with a planned impact.

missions.name: Japan: Hagoromo
missions.goals: Demonstrate a small lunar orbital satellite.
missions.outcome: Uncertain. Radio failure prevented confirmation of lunar orbit or its eventual impact.

missions.name: NASA: Lunar Prospector
missions.goals: Map lunar composition, gravity, magnetism, and polar hydrogen.
missions.outcome: Success. Completed orbital science and ended with a planned polar impact.

missions.name: ESA: SMART-1
missions.goals: Test solar electric propulsion and survey the Moon.
missions.outcome: Success. Completed technology and science work, ending with a controlled impact.

missions.name: India: Chandraya'an 1 MIP
missions.goals: Test lunar impact technology and measure the environment during descent.
missions.outcome: Success. Returned descent measurements before intentional impact.

missions.name: Japan: Okina

missions.outcome: Success. Supported lunar gravity mapping before impact.

missions.name: Japan: Ouna
missions.goals: Support Kaguya radio tracking and lunar gravity measurements.
missions.outcome: Supported the gravity experiment. Its eventual surface location is unknown.

missions.name: China: Chang'e 1
missions.goals: Map lunar topography and composition from orbit.
missions.outcome: Success. Completed orbital mapping and ended with an intentional impact.

missions.name: Japan: Kaguya
missions.goals: Map lunar topography, composition, gravity, and the environment.
missions.outcome: Success. Completed orbital science and ended with a controlled impact.

missions.name: NASA: LCROSS Centaur
missions.goals: Excavate polar material by impact so its plume could be analyzed.
missions.outcome: Success. The intentional impact enabled detection of water in Cabeus material.

missions.name: NASA: LCROSS spacecraft
missions.goals: Observe the Centaur impact plume to search for water and other volatiles.
missions.outcome: Success. Returned plume measurements before its own planned impact.

missions.name: NASA: GRAIL A

missions.outcome: Success. Completed gravity mapping and ended with a controlled impact.

missions.name: NASA: GRAIL B

missions.name: China: Yutu Rover
missions.goals: Investigate lunar geology and subsurface structure while traversing the surface.
missions.outcome: Partial success. Returned science data, but a mobility failure curtailed the traverse.

missions.name: NASA: LADEE
missions.goals: Study the lunar exosphere and dust environment.
missions.outcome: Success. Completed science operations and ended with a planned impact.

missions.name: China: Chang'e 4

missions.name: China: Yutu 2

missions.outcome: Success. Returned images and scientific measurements during an extended traverse.

missions.name: SpaceIL: Beresheet

missions.outcome: Failure. Crashed during final descent.

missions.name: China: Longjiang 2
missions.goals: Demonstrate small-spacecraft lunar communications and conduct radio observations.
missions.outcome: Success. Operated in lunar orbit before a planned impact.

missions.name: India: Vikram (Chandrayaan-2)
missions.goals: Soft-land near the south polar region and deploy Pragyan.
missions.outcome: Failure of the lander. Crashed during descent; the separate Chandrayaan-2 orbiter operated successfully.

missions.name: China: Chang'e 5
missions.goals: Collect near-side lunar samples and return them to Earth.
missions.outcome: Success. Returned lunar samples to Earth.

missions.name: China: Chang'e 5 Ascent Craft
missions.goals: Lift samples from the surface and transfer them to the return spacecraft.
missions.outcome: Success. Transferred samples in lunar orbit and was subsequently deorbited.

missions.name: China: Chang'e 5-T1 Booster
missions.goals: Provide launch propulsion for the mission attributed to this spent stage.
missions.outcome: The later lunar impact was an uncontrolled spent-stage event. NASA lists its identification as probable.

missions.name: ispace: Hakuto-R Mission 1

missions.outcome: Failure. Crashed during final descent.

missions.name: Russia: Luna 25

missions.outcome: Failure. Crashed during an orbital maneuver before landing.

missions.name: India: Chandrayaan 3
missions.goals: Demonstrate a soft landing, rover operations, and surface science.
missions.outcome: Success. Landed and deployed Pragyan.

missions.name: Japan: SLIM
missions.goals: Demonstrate precise lunar landing technology.
missions.outcome: Success in precision landing. Landed in an abnormal attitude that restricted initial power and operations.

missions.name: Intuitive Machines: Odysseus (IM-1)
missions.goals: Deliver NASA CLPS instruments and demonstrate commercial lunar landing.
missions.outcome: Partial success. Landed tipped over and returned payload data with restricted operations.

missions.name: China: Chang'e 6

missions.outcome: Success. First sample return from the far side.

missions.name: Firefly: Blue Ghost 1

missions.outcome: Limited success. Landed on its side in a crater; the mission ended early and planned drilling was not completed.

missions.name: ispace: Hakuto-R Mission 2
missions.goals: Demonstrate commercial lunar delivery and deploy the TENACIOUS rover.
missions.outcome: Failure. RESILIENCE made a hard landing and the planned surface mission was lost.
